pr.title: Fix search saying No items yet. when nothing matches

lenses.note: The PR's words match the diff. This is a small bug fix with one reasonable design. The message wording is dictated by the PR and the test.
There is no spec file in this change.

test/search.test.js adds three tests: no matches, escaping, and an empty table with a search. Each asserts the exact

output, so each fails if the logic is wrong. No tests were deleted or loosened. I could not run the suite because Bash was denied.
README.md only says ?q= searches titles. It does not describe empty-state messages, so nothing is stale.

The count query runs only when a search finds nothing. The message is chosen correctly for three cases: empty table, search with no matches, and no search. The search text is escaped through escapeHtml. No dead code.
The user-supplied q is HTML-escaped before it goes into the message, and a test covers this. The page template inserts `empty` raw, but every value passed in is either a constant or escaped.
The diff changes one text string in the server-rendered HTML. It touches no CSS, layout or UI components.
The diff touches no UI flow beyond a text message, and the PR says no browser was available.

The title is under 72 characters and describes the observable change. The body's claims match the diff: the escaping, the unchanged 'No items yet.' for an empty table, no tests deleted, and the new tests.
